limitations: All numerical eigenvalues are heuristic; absence of a negative signal does not certify PSD.
An exact negative vector rejects only its matching-specific closed28 graph, subject to independently checked closure and Gram necessity.
Only one saved matching per sampled star was examined; a rejected witness does not exclude the star or all its matchings.
No producer filter or numerical scoring modules imported; NumPy is used only for eigenvector guidance.
